headerDisplay: Exposes pollen levels from the [Ambee API](https://www.getambee.com/) as HomeKit contact sensors for automation.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Your Ambee API key. Get one at https://api-dashboard.getambee.com/

location.title: Location
location.description: Zip code or place name to fetch pollen data for.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollInterval.description: How often to fetch pollen data from Ambee. Minimum 15 minutes. Free tier allows ~100 calls/day.

enableCategorySensors.title: Enable Per-Category Sensors
enableCategorySensors.description: Add 9 additional sensors for Tree/Grass/Weed x High/Medium/Low.

enableAirQualitySensor.title: Enable Air Quality Sensor
enableAirQualitySensor.description: Add an AirQualitySensor accessory that maps overall pollen count to a 1-5 severity scale.

thresholds.title: Threshold Overrides
thresholds.description: Override default pollen count thresholds for level classification.

low.title: Low Threshold
low.description: Counts at or below this value are classified as Low.

high.title: High Threshold
high.description: Counts at or above this value are classified as High.
